name: Amber Breaker
source:
Amber Breaker infiltrates the enemy's lair in search of the missing Ruby and Lapis. However, she too gets caught in Zodiac's web and, at his mercy, is consumed, body and spirit, in an unimaginable maelstrom of agony, humiliation, and ecstasy. To make things worse, the allies Amber came to save appear before her, and at their hands, she suffers mind-breaking and body-crushing euphoric torture. Just what waits at the end of her journey? 

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?aflg=18over&product_code=135&af=3a123f6214695bfacaa881bd3117c693]MangaGamer[/url]]
translation:
琥珀破坏者为了寻找失踪的红宝石与青金石，潜入敌人的巢穴。然而，她也落入了黄道设下的罗网，只能任其摆布；她的肉体与精神都被卷入难以想象的痛苦、屈辱与快感漩涡，逐渐遭到吞噬。更糟的是，琥珀本想救出的伙伴出现在她面前，她却在那些伙伴手中承受了摧毁心智、碾碎肉体的快感拷问。旅途尽头等待她的，究竟会是什么？

[引自[url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?aflg=18over&product_code=135&af=3a123f6214695bfacaa881bd3117c693]MangaGamer[/url]]
